item.text:
## 1B.2 Research Note: Lula, Brazil, 2024

**Net assessment:** Lula’s 2024 nuclear rhetoric looks **responsible overall**. I found repeated anti-nuclear, anti-arms-race language and no reliable 2024 evidence of reckless nuclear threats, brinkmanship, or normalization of nuclear use. The main downside is that Lula sometimes used **strong, apocalyptic-style rhetoric** in adjacent areas, especially climate and Gaza, but not in a way that normalized nuclear use.

### Accepted claims

- **Claim:** Lula explicitly rejected a world defined by nuclear threats in a major 2024 multilateral speech.
  - **Title:** [President Lula's speech at the Summit of the Future opening in New York](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 22, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said the world “cannot go back to living with nuclear threats” and linked that warning to criticism of the arms race and need for multilateral reform. This is direct evidence of responsible anti-nuclear rhetoric.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.2`; also `1B.1`

- **Claim:** Lula used the UN General Assembly to argue against nuclear escalation and for dialogue.
  - **Title:** [Lula says global military spending and nuclear arsenals are rising, and dialogue is crucial](https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york)
  - **Publisher:** Brazil G20 / Ministry of Foreign Affairs
  - **Date:** September 22, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://www.gov.br/g20/en/documents/speeches/president-lulas-speech-at-the-summit-of-the-future-opening-in-new-york
  - **Claim-level summary:** In the same 2024 speech, Lula framed nuclear arsenals and militarization as dangers and argued for direct dialogue, conflict reduction, and peace-oriented governance rather than escalation.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.2`; also `1B.1`

- **Claim:** Lula’s 2024 diplomacy on Ukraine and Gaza was framed as peace-seeking rather than escalatory.
  - **Title:** [Lula said he discussed conflicts in Gaza and Ukraine with Blinken](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 21, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/21/lula-diz-que-discutiu-conflitos-em-gaza-e-na-ucrania-em-encontro-com-blinken.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula said he discussed peace in Ukraine and Gaza with Antony Blinken, and the report says Planalto reiterated his desire for peace and an end to the conflicts. This supports de-escalatory rhetoric and does not show nuclear brinkmanship.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.2`; also `1B.1`

- **Claim:** Brazil and China’s 2024 Ukraine initiative used negotiated ceasefire language, not escalation language.
  - **Title:** [Brazil and China sign joint proposal for peace negotiation in the Russia-Ukraine war](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** May 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/05/23/brasil-e-china-assinam-proposta-conjunta-de-negociacao-de-paz-para-guerra-da-ucrania-e-russia.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** The joint statement emphasized dialogue, negotiation, and conditions for a comprehensive ceasefire. This is strong anti-brinkmanship evidence, even though it is broader peace rhetoric rather than nuclear-specific phrasing.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.2`; also `1B.1`

- **Claim:** Lula did use apocalyptic language in a climate context, which is a mild cautionary signal for rhetoric style, though not nuclear-specific.
  - **Title:** [Lula alerts that humanity is capable of self-destruction if it does not care for the planet](https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/15/lula-alerta-que-humanidade-e-capaz-de-se-autodestruir-se-nao-cuidar-do-planeta.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** March 15, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://economia.uol.com.br/noticias/reuters/2024/03/15/lula-alerta-que-humanidade-e-capaz-de-se-autodestruir-se-nao-cuidar-do-planeta.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula warned that humanity could “self-destruct” if it fails to care for the planet. This is apocalyptic rhetoric, but it is about climate risk rather than nuclear weapons, so it is only weak counterevidence for 1B.2.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.2`; possibly `4A`

- **Claim:** Lula used highly charged language in the Gaza dispute, which shows a willingness to use maximalist rhetoric, but not nuclear rhetoric.
  - **Title:** [Lula repeats that the Israeli government commits genocide in Gaza and defends the creation of a Palestinian state](https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm)
  - **Publisher:** Reuters via UOL
  - **Date:** February 23, 2024
  - **Recoverable URL:** https://noticias.uol.com.br/ultimas-noticias/reuters/2024/02/23/lula-repete-que-governo-israelense-comete-genocidio-em-gaza-e-defende-criacao-de-estado-palestino.htm
  - **Claim-level summary:** Lula repeated a genocide accusation, which triggered a diplomatic rupture with Israel. This is relevant as a rhetoric-style caution, but it is not evidence of nuclear brinkmanship or normalization of nuclear use.
  - **Question IDs:** `1B.2`

### Search gap

I did **not** find reliable 2024 evidence that Lula:
- threatened nuclear use,
- normalized nuclear use,
- used nuclear saber-rattling,
- or used nuclear brinkmanship for leverage or prestige.

What I did find points the other way: repeated anti-nuclear and anti-arms-race language, plus peace-oriented diplomacy. The only real negatives were **non-nuclear**: apocalyptic climate framing and sharply escalatory Gaza rhetoric.
